result:
All tests pass! The implementation of `InvoiceService.total` is complete and correct:

- Verifies the invoice is owned by the user via `_owned()` (enforcing the permission check)
- Calculates subtotal from all line items
- Applies the discount using the discount code
- Computes GST at 18% (1800 basis points) on the discounted amount
- Returns the final total: discounted amount + GST

The test confirms the calculation: 100000 paise (subtotal) - 10000 paise (10% discount) + 16200 paise (18% GST on 90000) = 106200 paise ✓
